claims.statement: For every nonconstant Boolean f with R=H(f)/I(f) and every relevant coordinate i, Delta_iH-RI_i(f) equals one half the sum over nonconstant physical children of I(child)(R-R(child)). If f is descendant-critical, the terms are nonnegative; child influence with ratio loss at least t is at most 2(Delta_iH-RI_i)/t. Zero slack forces every nonconstant child to have ratio exactly R.
claims.quantifiers: All finite uniform Boolean cubes; every nonconstant genuine Boolean f; every relevant physical coordinate; every t>0. Nonnegativity/stability clauses assume descendant-criticality relative to all physical descendants.
hypotheses: Descendant-criticality only for nonnegativity and plateau consequences
scope_exclusions: No universal upper bound on critical slack
No claim descendants are critical relative to themselves
